}}'''Essonde''' is a senior [[sul'dam|der'sul'dam]] assigned to the ''[[damane]]'' kennels in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Essonde}}

== Activities ==
[[Bethamin Zeami]] threatens to report [[Renna Emain]] to Essonde.{{ref/book|9|20}} Later, Essonde confronts [[Egeanin Tamarath]], Renna and [[Teslyn Baradon]] as they are trying to leave the ''damane'' pens in the [[Tarasin Palace]]. Egeanin manages to convince Essonde that everything is in order.{{ref/book|9|31}}
